summary.text: Ryan Braunberger is the Democratic-NPL nominee for Secretary of State and a Fargo state senator. He says he is running to boost public trust in elections; in July 2026 he agreed with Howe that North Dakota's voter data and results are secure.

paragraphs.text: Born in Fargo; earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Minnesota State University Moorhead in 2022 and an associate degree in business administration in 2007.
Fargo state senator (District 10), first elected in 2022.
